title: Christmas Fayre News
summary: Christmas Fayre spotlight: running order, sponsors and supporters, a Glitter Tree code, the Art Competition and where we still need helpers.

sections.title: Dear Parents, Carers and Teachers,
paragraphs: This week's newsletter is a spotlight on our Christmas Fayre on Saturday 5th December, and we can't wait to see you all there! Inside: the running order for the day, the sponsors and supporters making it happen, a Glitter Tree code for 10% off Christmas gifts, how to enter the Art Competition (entries in by Monday 30th November), and where we still need helpers. We also have the last Pre-loved Uniform sale of the term on Friday 4th December.

sections.title: Christmas Fayre: Saturday 5th December, 12pm - 3pm
paragraphs: Step through the wardrobe into Narnia at Ashley School for an afternoon of festive fun! Entry is £2 and children under 12 go free, tickets on the door.
We would love a few more helpers to run the stalls. Come and join in the fun, and sign up here: [Christmas Fayre volunteering page](https://www.thefriendsofashley.org/christmas-fayre-volunteering/)
list: 1:00pm: Art Competition winners announced with Steph Cotela, organising the competition for her tenth and last year
1:15pm: Christmas tree auction, with trees from [Ottershaw Christmas Tree Farm](https://www.mauricemandry.com/)

sections.title: A big thank you to our wonderful Fayre sponsors and supporters

sections.title: Christmas gifts with The Glitter Tree: 10% off, 10% back to Ashley
paragraphs: Christmas gifts that give back: use THEFRIENDSOFASHLEY at checkout for 10% off [The Glitter Tree](https://theglittertree.com/pages/rewards), with 10% back to Ashley through the FOA. [Shop glitter tattoo kits](https://www.theglittertree.com/pages/glitter-tattoo-kits-buyers-guide) for stocking fillers and presents.

sections.title: Christmas Fayre Art Competition: entries in by Monday 30th November
paragraphs: The theme is Narnia (winter wonderland and Christmas themes welcome too). One entry per child, any medium, A4 ideal. Hand entries in at the box in the Hall (windowsill near the doors) or to the school office. Every entry will be on display at the Fayre, so get creating! Details: [Art Competition page](https://www.thefriendsofashley.org/christmas-fayre-art-competition/)

sections.title: Pre-loved Uniform and Christmas Jumpers: Friday 4th December, 3:25pm
paragraphs: Our last sale of the term, in the school playground (subject to weather). Christmas jumpers will be on sale, and we are collecting jumpers in good condition (age 5 and up) to sell. Coats and new-logo items £3, Christmas jumpers £2, everything else £1, card only. [Pre-loved uniform page](https://www.thefriendsofashley.org/uniform/)

sections.title: The FOA, wherever you are
paragraphs: Bookmark (or search “FOA”) [the FOA website](https://www.thefriendsofashley.org) for dates, tickets and volunteering. Follow [@thefriendsofashley](https://www.instagram.com/thefriendsofashley/) on Instagram.

sections.title: Could you lead the Summer Fete or Big Picnic?
paragraphs: Let one of the Committee know or [email us](mailto:thefriendsofashley@gmail.com).
